parameters.query:
INSERT INTO order_cancellations (order_id)
SELECT $1::text
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE order_id = $1::text)
ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING order_id;

nodes.name: Build cancellation notice
nodes.notes: Why Code: writes the owner's cancellation notice from an en/es message table with the Bogota time and a readable reason

parameters.content:
## Record the cancellation
Records the cancellation once, and only for an order this store recorded. A repeated delivery, or a cancellation for an unknown order, stops here: no row change, no email.

## Mark the order and tell the owner
Sets the order's Orders row to "cancelled" (matched by order_number), then emails the owner a plain-text notice in the team language. Process order checks the same record after its wait, so a cancelled order gets no brewing guide and no reorder reminder.

NOTE: a cancellation that arrives before its order was recorded is ignored, and the order stays "placed". Ceiling: Shopify sends orders/create first in practice. Upgrade path: park the cancellation and replay it when the order is recorded.
